card.title: PS5 TPS53219A buck controller converts +12V to +5V STBY

claims.statement: The TPS53219A single buck controller converts the +12V power supply input into +5V STBY.
claims.evidence: Source diagram labels TPS53219A as generating +5V STBY from the +12V power supply.
claims.quote: This power regulator will generate +5v STBY. It is created from the +12V power supply.

claims.statement: The +5V STBY rail is used to create other standby power rails on the motherboard.
claims.evidence: Source states that additional power rails are derived from +5V STBY.
claims.quote: The +5V STBY is used to create other power rails

card.caveats: The source labels TPS53219A as the +5V STBY controller but does not detail pinout voltages or measurements.
